commands: tooling/install-skills.sh --target <application>/.agents/skills --skill repo-bootstrap --skill qa-bootstrap --skill release-readiness --skill test-gap-finder --skill security-audit-lite --skill spec-driven-development --replace-existing
upgradePolicy: Review exact upstream commit in a PR, run installers with documented refresh options, review generated diffs, run application acceptance and agent QA before merge. Never follow an unpinned branch in CI.
revisionNote: Published immutable v2.3.0 release. Refreshes read-only activation diagnostics, tracked documentation validation, and tool-independent specification guidance. Preserves existing explicit installation, advisory selections, manual lifecycle/polyglot, consumer-owned configuration and QA, and the independent Snyk failure example.
refreshMethod: Stage tracked application files without this application-owned provenance record (not a CLI managed-file lock); run canonical standalone installers; apply generated runtime/workflow/skill differences only; retain this lock format and update its source/version fields.
